description:
Update the Ground Floor HVAC systems in the eQUEST model to match approved manufacturer shop drawings. Navigate to the Air-Side HVAC module and modify all five Ground Floor (G.*) packaged single-zone systems (`G.S1`, `G.E2`, `G.N3`, `G.W4`, `G.C5`) with the following specifications:

1. **Fan Placement**: Change from Draw-Through to **Blow-Through**.
2. **Supply Static Pressure**: Change to **2.75** in. w.g.
3. **Supply Fan Efficiency**: Change to **0.62**.

After updating all five systems, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
